title: 数据科学与机器学习笔记本项目

summary_en: This project contains the author's completed Nodebook Data Science & Machine Learning program projects, covering Python, ML, DL, LLMs, generative AI, and AI agents, demonstrating hands-on experience in building smart systems that can think, plan, and act.
